description: Set the default integrator fee of a Trnch partner, an integer from 0 to 100 basis points. Returns { partner, bps, maxBps, previousBps }. Each change is recorded with its channel. 400 for a value out of range. Authentication: header X-Trnch-Partner-Key linked to a Trnch partner, or Authorization: Bearer <API key> of the partner payout wallet; 401 otherwise. 20 calls per minute per IP (429).

bps.description: New default integrator fee in basis points (100 = 1%).

name: trnch_partner_fee_set
title: Set the partner integrator fee
